claim: yardd daemon tests flaked: a test daemon that lost its port to a parallel test exited, and the test talked to the other test's yardd instead
head: baaef76faef7b13478dfe65b1a0523e1689375cf

proofs.text: no-repro: a race between parallel tests. Seen in this run: accounts_are_per_host_through_the_hub failed at 'the folder is on the remote'; the kept sandbox /tmp/yardd-test-643134-accounts-remote-20/data/yardd.log reads 'Error: cannot listen on 127.0.0.1:33995: Address already in use', so the hub had added another test's yardd as its remote

no-failing-test: the race needs a port taken between free_port() and yardd's bind, which no test can schedule without a hook. Checked by hand at head: holding the first port picked made yardd exit with Address already in use, and the test still passed on the retry (temporary patch, not committed)

proofs.cmd: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test -p yardd --test daemon accounts_are_per_host_through_the_hub
